Name: Hiram, King of Tyre
Summary: Hiram, king of Tyre, sent messengers, cedar trees, carpenters, and masons to David and built him a house at Jerusalem, a sign that David's kingdom was established. Also known as Huram.
KeyStory: Hiram of Tyre built David a cedar house, the first foreign recognition of his kingdom.
KeyVerses: 2 Samuel 5:11; 1 Kings 5:1; 1 Kings 5:10; 1 Chronicles 14:1; 2 Chronicles 2:3; 2 Chronicles 2:11; 2 Chronicles 2:12
RelatedPeople: King David; King Solomon; Hiram, Craftsman of Tyre; Huram, the Craftsman
LifeLesson: Foreign kings honouring God's anointed is itself a testimony.
